sections.text:
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 240. Success value 100. 5x magic damage (Wind).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all enemies. Success value 110. Prohibits Unison for 60 seconds.
-Target: all enemies. Applies Rejection for 40 seconds with a success value of 80.
-Target: all allies. Applies blessing (recovers 50 Cost, increases max HP by 100%, nullifies status ailments and Unison Gauge reduction effects, reduces cooldown times by 50%, and recovers 20% of max HP every 5 seconds) for 60 seconds.
-Target: all allies excluding yourself. Fills Unison gauge by 30.
-Target: yourself. Applies Protection for 90 seconds (When in effect, damage to HP and CP will not be taken; increases DEF and MDEF by 100%; nullifies status ailments, debuffs, and buff removal effects. Removed after receiving a set amount of damage (300% of max HP excluding buff and field effects)).
-Applies Cradle Element (increases max HP by 100%, nullifies buff removal effects and debuffs, and increases attack Ability accuracy by 30%) to the allied Field for 120 seconds.
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 by 11000
Increases stats selected in stat slot 2 by 11000
